s: Seder haqqiddush ubo h' seipim: seder haqqiddush belel a' shel sukkot, battechilla mebarek al hayyayin, veachar kak omer qiddush hayyom, veachar kak yebarek "lesheb bassukka", shehare al korchaka tzarik hayyom lehitqaddesh techilla qodem sheyyitchayyeb besukka, veachar kak mebarek "shehecheyanu" baacharona, lepi shebberaka zo chozeret al qiddush hayyom veal mitzvat sukka, kemo shennitbaer besiman trm"a, ayyen sham:

Venohagim sheen medaqdeqim laamod bishat haqqiddush ella meqaddeshin apillu meyushshab, veap birkat "lesheb bassukka" omerim apillu meyushshab. Veap al pi shekkol hammitzvot mebarek alehem ober laasiyyatan, vehaya nakon lebarek "lesheb bassukka" qodem sheyyesheb leekol, shehayshiba hi hammitzva, shenneemar "bassukkot teshebu", veap al pi sheen mitzva kelal lesheb mammash, she"teshebu" hu lashon titakkebu, kemo shenneemar "vatteshebu beqadesh yamim rabbim", mikkol maqom en lebarek ella beshaa shennikkar haakkaba vehaqqebiut, dehaynu bishiba mammash, shebbazeh mareh atzmo sherotzeh lehitakkeb sham, abal kol sheomed en nikkar kelal haakkaba vehaqqebiut sheepshar shettekep yachazor veyetze. Vekevan sheiqqar hammitzva hi haakkaba vehaqqebiut haya rauy lebarek qodem haakkaba vehaqqebiut, dehaynu qodem hayshiba, ella shellepi sheiqqar hammitzva sheanu mebarekin aleha hi haakila, shehare im yosheb bassukka veeno okel eno mebarek kemo shennitbaer besiman trl"t, lepikak en anu chosheshin ella lehaqdim habberaka lehaakila shehi iqqar hammitzva shealeha mebarekin, abal lo lehaqdimah lipne hayshiba vehaqqebiut, lepi shehi lebaddah belo akila enah iqqar hammitzva shealeha mebarekin:

Vekol zeh belel yom tob o belel shabbat sheyyesh bahen qiddush hayyom lekak hu somek birkat hassukka leqiddush hayyom, abal bishar seudot hechag, apillu bisudat shabbat veyom tob shacharit shemmebarek al hakkos, kevan sheeno omer qiddush hayyom — eno omer "lesheb bassukka" qodem shetiyyat hakkos, lepi shetztzarik lismok beraka zo lehaakila shehi iqqar hammitzva shealeha mebarekin:

Umin haddin haya rauy lebarek beraka zo qodem birkat "hammotzi", shehare chobat beraka zo chal alayv mittechilla miyyad sheyyesheb leekol verauy lehaqdimah lebirkat hammotzi sheenah choba alayv ad sherotzeh litom. Umikkol maqom nohagim haolam lebarek beraka zo achar birkat "hammotzi", lepi shebbirkat "hammotzi" hi hatchalat hasseuda, verau haolam lehatchil bisuda qodem birkat hassukka, lepi sheen mebarekin birkat hassukka ella bishat seuda, veen birkat hassukka chashuba hepseq ben birkat "hammotzi" laakila, kevan shebberaka zo hi mitztzorke hasseuda vekol shehu letzorek hasseuda eno chashub hepseq, kemo shennitbaer besiman qas"[z]:

Im lo berak "shehecheyanu" belel harishon venizkar lemachar — omer beshaa shennizkar apillu shello al hakkos. Veim lo nizkar lemachar, vegam belel sheni shakach velo berak "shehecheyanu", venizkar beechad mishshear yeme hechag — yebarek ematay shennizkar, shebbirkat "shehecheyanu" yesh lah tashlumin kol shiba, kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"g leinyan pesach, ella shebbechag hassukkot keshehu mebarek "shehecheyanu" — tzarik lebarek tok hassukka, kede liptor gam et hassukka, kemo shennitbaer besiman trm"a:
